extensionDescription.message: Rest your mouse on a picture: it fills the screen, with the post right beside it. Free and open source. Nothing is sent to us.

sitesHint.message: Previews only run on these sites. One domain per line; subdomains are included. To use it on another site, open that site, click Zizai in the toolbar and turn it on.

sitesInvalid.message: Check the list for an invalid hostname.

shortcutHoldOnly.message: Press Shift, Alt, Ctrl, or the system key by itself.

shortcutNeedsModifier.message: Add Alt, Ctrl, or Command to the site shortcut.

shortcutReserved.message: $VALUE$ is reserved by the browser or system.

shortcutConflict.message: That shortcut is already used for $VALUE$.

settingsError.message: Settings are unavailable. Reopen the popup and try again.

copyGif.message: Copied as a still image. GIF animation is not preserved.

copyFailure.message: Could not copy this image. The site may restrict access.

copyUnavailable.message: The image clipboard is unavailable on this page.

feedbackPending.message: Feedback links will be added at release.

enabledHint.message: Enable or pause previews across all sites

unsupportedPage.message: Previews are unavailable on this page

showCaptionHint.message: Show the author and post text next to the image

shortcutInstructions.message: Click a key field and press a new shortcut. Esc cancels. Typing and copying selected text stay with the page.

guideHoverImage.message: Rest your mouse on this picture

demoBody.message: I took the long way home and found this lake. The mountains and clouds slowed down. Some detours are worth taking.

guidePrivacy.message: No account. Nothing is sent to us. Settings stay on this computer.

guideStartTitle.message:
Just pause.
It comes to you.

guideStartBody.message: Rest your mouse on the picture on the left. No clicking: it fills the view, with the author and post right beside it.

guideFullBody.message: Scroll on the big picture to see the next one. Wheel, trackpad or ← → keys all work.

guideCopyBody.message: Click the picture, or the space around it, to close.

guideReadyBody.message: Weibo, Jike, X, Instagram and a few more are ready. For any other site, follow the three steps on the left, then refresh the page.

previewThumbnailFallback.message: The full image is unavailable. Showing the thumbnail.

previewUnavailable.message: This image can’t be opened right now. Try again later.

readFullPost.message: Press $KEY$ to read the full post

captionTruncated.message: The page shows only part of this post. Open the post to read it all.

videoUnavailable.message: This video can't play here. Open the post to watch it.

videoAutoMuted.message: The browser blocked sound, so it's playing muted. Press $KEY$ for sound.

saveFailure.message: Couldn't save this image; the site may block it.

copyTextSuccess.message: Copied the post text (with author and link)

videoMirrored.message: This video can only reuse the page player's picture, so the site decides its quality.

sitePermissionDenied.message: Access to this site wasn't allowed, so previews stay off here.

sitesNeedPermission.message: New sites need your OK to access them, so they weren't saved. You can also open the site and turn it on here.

guideSite1.message: Click Zizai in the toolbar. Not there? Pin it from the puzzle icon first.

guideSite2.message: In its settings, turn on "Enable image preview".

guideSite3.message: When Chrome asks, click Allow. Each site asks only once.

guideAlsoVideo.message: a click pauses; click outside it to close

guideAlsoMore.message: click the red dot in the corner, or press Esc

guideDoneClose.message: ✓ Closed. Move away and back to open it again
